evidence: The immutable PR #353 baseline covers 110 assets, while the current registry contains 112 assets.
PR #354, PR #355, and PR #357 reviewed 15 of the original 18 Tier A candidates.
Thirteen selected candidates received bounded canonical improvements and two were reviewed with no safe canonical change.
Three original candidates were not consumed by the completed dossier batches: poundtoken, USDG, and USDS.
The old baseline cannot measure current post-batch Compare, Timeline, Market Access, or evidence-maintenance leverage.
The PR #353 baseline classified all 110 assets as usable and none as strong for comparison readiness.
No reviewed post-PR #360 Record Depth delta exists to establish which dossier changes materially improved Compare utility.
The current registry contains 187 events with typed details for all 187 events.
The completed dossier sequence did not establish a reviewed density metric by asset or material event family.
Canonical Market Access increased from zero to eight records.
All eight records currently cover two assets, one jurisdiction, and one platform/service context.
The pilots validate schema, evidence, and manual-review governance but do not yet provide broad access utility.
The repository does not contain a canonical monitoring-signal-to-reviewed-merge conversion metric.
Monitoring therefore remains useful for discovery but is not evidence for automatic promotion or a larger publication surface.
PR #360 improved archive coverage from 380 to 387 records.
One hundred seventy canonical Evidence records still have no archive recorded.
Evidence maintenance remains a material ongoing workload rather than a completed cleanup.
No repository-authoritative burden metric establishes that the current monthly cycle should expand or contract.
The existing public-safe monthly maintenance boundary remains sufficient.
No repository-authoritative usage or referral checkpoint was available at this review gate.
A new public page, explorer, dashboard, ranking surface, or navigation family is therefore not authorized.

approved_sequence.item: post-PR 360 review gate and authority reset

decision.rationale: The next competitive gain is more likely to come from measuring and deepening the existing 112-asset registry, broadening narrowly proven Market Access utility, and reducing Evidence maintenance debt than from immediately adding more assets or public surfaces.
